name: Browser Control
description: Advanced browser automation with form filling, data extraction, and session management using Playwright
author: openmotoko

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate the browser to a URL

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element matching a CSS selector

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type text into an element matching a CSS selector

selector.description: CSS selector of the input element

text.description: Text to type into the element

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Auto-fill a form with provided field values. Detects input fields and fills them.

fields.description: Key-value pairs where key is the field name/id/label and value is the text to fill

submit.description: Whether to submit the form after filling

tools.name: extract_data
tools.description: Extract structured data from the page using CSS selectors

selectors.description: Named selectors to extract text from, e.g. { "title": "h1", "price": ".price" }

table_selector.description: CSS selector for a table to extract as structured data

tools.name: extract_links
tools.description: Extract all links from the page, optionally filtered by selector

selector.description: CSS selector to scope link extraction (default: whole page)

tools.name: get_cookies
tools.description: Get all cookies for the current page

tools.name: set_cookies
tools.description: Set cookies on the current browser context

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in the page context and return the result

script.description: JavaScript code to evaluate in the page

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait for an element to appear on the page
